title: Kompass: Elections in detail & political participation
tip: Read the Kompass first: it gives you the key facts behind every question in this block.

exercises.title: Kompass: Elections in detail & political participation (1/2)
exercises.body: Election mechanics get granular here. The five **Wahlrechtsgrundsätze** (Art. 38 GG): **allgemein** (every citizen 18+), **unmittelbar** (you elect MPs directly, no electoral college), **frei** (no pressure), **gleich** (every vote weighs the same), **geheim** (nobody can see your ballot). **Aktives Wahlrecht** = the right to vote; **passives Wahlrecht** = the right to BE elected. The **5%-Hürde** keeps micro-parties out, a direct lesson from Weimar's splintered, ungovernable parliaments.

exercises.title: Kompass: Elections in detail & political participation (2/2)
exercises.body: Democracy between elections: **Briefwahl** (postal voting), **Wahlbenachrichtigung** (the notification card your Gemeinde mails), **Wahlhelfer** (volunteer poll workers who count ballots), **Bürgerinitiativen** (citizens' initiatives), **Ehrenamt** (unpaid volunteering, the backbone of German civil society), **Gewerkschaften** (unions, for employees). Deep German trivia: the only civic duty citizens can be *drafted* into is serving as a poll worker or Schöffe.

exercises.title: Kompass auf Deutsch: Wahlen im Detail & politische Teilhabe
exercises.body: Wahlgrundsätze: allgemein, unmittelbar, frei, gleich, geheim. 5%-Hürde hält Kleinstparteien draußen. Briefwahl ist erlaubt, Wählen ist ein Recht (keine Pflicht). Teilhabe geht auch ohne Wahl: Ehrenamt, Bürgerinitiative, Gewerkschaft.
